choose.NAME: Choose the person. A name alone never opens a record.

clarify.DATE: Which day? For example “yesterday” or “8 ต.ค. 2569”.
clarify.EMPLOYEE: Which employee? Add their employee code.
clarify.SITE: Which site? Choose a page below and filter by site.
clarify.TASK: What would you like to do? Try one of these.
clarify.RANGE: Which period? Write its dates, e.g. “19–25 ก.ย. 2569”.
clarify.DATE_UNSUPPORTED: That date expression is not supported yet. Write the date, e.g. “8 ต.ค. 2569”.
clarify.DATE_INVALID: That date does not exist. Check the day, month and year.
clarify.DATE_AMBIGUOUS: That date could mean more than one day. Write it as “8 ต.ค. 2569”.
clarify.FUTURE_DATE: That day has not happened yet.
clarify.EMPLOYEE_UNCONFIRMED: The employee could not be confirmed from your text. Add their exact employee code.
clarify.VERSION_INVALID: That version could not be read. Write it as “v1” or “ฉบับ 1”, or leave it out for the current version.
clarify.VERSION_UNAVAILABLE: That version of the period is not available. Nothing was opened.
